subject: Discovery recap: procurement readiness & pay-path heatmap — Solara Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@solarahealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap: procurement readiness & pay-path heatmap — Solara Health

Hi Elena — thanks again for the time today. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared thread.

Call highlights:
- Solara intends to pilot inference for clinical summarization across two teams (Clinical Ops + Quality).
- Procurement is flexible but wants to confirm invoicing path (PO vs. card) and marketplace options.
- Primary economic buyer: Vikram Shah (Director, Data Platforms). Finance sponsor is typically Procurement + AP.

Open questions I promised to confirm:
1) Does Solara require a purchase order to start pilot (yes/no) and if yes, any PO template we should expect?
2) Any vendor onboarding steps beyond SOC2 / security questionnaire?
3) Preferred billing cadence and payment method for pilots (net30 with PO, or upfront card)?

Next steps (proposed):
- I will share a short pay-path heatmap showing tradeoffs (card vs PO vs marketplace). Attachment: solara_paypath_heatmap_v1.png
- Please introduce Vikram Shah or procurement@solarahealth.com on this thread if you'd like us to map approvals and signatory path.
- Jordan will prepare a one-pager on terms and PO handling for pilot agreements.

If this looks right, can you loop Vikram or procurement and tell us whether a PO is required to get started?

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0172

Attachment: solara_paypath_heatmap_v1.png (image)
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@solarahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vikram Shah <vikram.shah@solarahealth.com>, procurement@solarahealth.com
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: procurement readiness & pay-path heatmap — Solara Health

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear recap and the heatmap — helpful. Quick answers from our side: 

- Pilot start: We prefer trials under a PO when procurement is involved, but for small POCs up to $5k the team can use a corporate card. For anything above $5k, Procurement will ask for an approved PO.
- PO template: attached (Solara_PO_policy.pdf) — shows approver tiers and when legal review is triggered.
- Onboarding: SOC2 is standard; we may require an additional data flow diagram for PHI adjacency (not direct PHI ingest but lives near it).

Looping Vikram and Procurement. Vikram — after you review Ben’s heatmap, can we set a 30-min sync to map approvers (economic buyer vs signatory) and confirm timelines?

Thanks,
Elena

--
Elena Morales
Product Lead, Clinical AI | Solara Health
elena.morales@solarahealth.com

Attachment: Solara_PO_policy.pdf (PDF)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vikram Shah <vikram.shah@solarahealth.com>, procurement@solarahealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: procurement readiness & pay-path heatmap — Solara Health

Vikram / Procurement team — appreciate the quick response, Elena. Attaching a short summary that calls out three commercial routes and suggested next steps for each: card (fast), PO (standard), marketplace (longer review but simplifies procurement at scale).

Quick ask to help us map internal approvals: can you confirm the following for the Solara pilot?
- Economic buyer (final budget approver): name & title
- Finance sponsor (who will champion AP reconciliation): name & title
- Legal / signatory level required for pilot under $25k

We can be flexible: if you need a short SOW + PO, Jordan can draft and Marissa will scope any required compliance addendum. Attached: redwood_terms_onepager.pdf and the earlier heatmap image.

Proposed meeting times (30 min): Tue 11 May 11:00-11:30 PT or Wed 12 May 09:00-09:30 PT. Please confirm what works.

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_terms_onepager.pdf, solara_paypath_heatmap_v1.png
From: Vikram Shah <vikram.shah@solarahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@solarahealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 08:49:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: procurement readiness & pay-path heatmap — Solara Health

Ben — thanks. Quick answers so we can keep momentum: 
- Economic buyer: Vikram Shah (me) — Director, Data Platforms — will sign off on budgets up to $50k for pilots.
- Finance sponsor: Anika Patel (AP Manager) — procurement@solarahealth.com will handle PO issuance and invoice routing.
- Legal/signatory: For pilots under $25k, signature from the Data Platforms Director is usually sufficient; above that we need Legal review.

We can do Tue 11 May 11:00 PT. Please send a calendar invite. Also, we need a short vendor security checklist (SOC2 + data flow diagram). Elena — I’ll coordinate the internal approvals after the call.

Vikram
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vikram Shah <vikram.shah@solarahealth.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@solarahealth.com>, procurement@solarahealth.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: procurement readiness & pay-path heatmap — Solara Health

Perfect — invite sent for Tue 11 May 11:00 PT. Attaching a single-slide walk-through (heatmap) and our SOC2 + short security checklist for the vendor intake.

Immediate next steps for Redwood (what we’ll do before Tue):
- Jordan: draft SOW option A (card pilot ~$3k) and option B (PO pilot $18k) — include payment path language for net30 PO.
- Marissa: compile SOC2 report + a redacted data flow diagram to share with your security team.
- Ben: prepare a short approval matrix we can share (economic buyer, finance sponsor, signatory) so procurement has one doc to attach to the PO.

When we meet we’ll aim to: confirm approver names on PO, agree pilot scope and timeline (45-day trial), and confirm required artifacts for vendor onboarding.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the sync.

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
